notes: v7.3.0 — i18n Translation Overhaul. (1) Fixed 582 broken values in zh.json that were storing key paths (e.g. 'actions.下潜') instead of proper Chinese text (e.g. '下潜') across actions/emotions/imagery/locations/subjects sections. (2) Migrated hardcoded Chinese strings in RemixStudio.jsx, PublishStudio.jsx, AutoCreativePanel.jsx, AutoProgressBar.jsx to use t() i18n calls with new keys added to both en.json and zh.json. (3) Added new i18n sections: remix (3 engine description keys), publish (6 toast/label keys), common.untitled, and 24 new keys in the auto section for phase labels, status strings, and panel texts. (4) Synchronized version numbers across VERSION.json, package.json, and android/app/build.gradle. (5) Verified zero Chinese/English mixing in user-facing UI strings.
